headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 13, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds secured a thrilling 9-8 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Eugenio Suárez leading the offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. Chicago White Sox right-handed pitcher Davis Martin has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right middle finger blister. The San Francisco Giants have transferred third baseman Matt Chapman from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to an abdominal strain. The Giants have also transferred right-handed pitcher Trevor McDonald from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right elbow strain.

The Baltimore Orioles have acquired center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox as part of the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade. The Red Sox will receive a player to be named later.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past White Sox 9-8**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a thrilling 9-8 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Eugenio Suárez leading the offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. Tejay Antone earned the win with a strong relief appearance, striking out 3 batters in 1 inning of work.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise to 13-1 Victory Over Marlins**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Miami Marlins, securing a 13-1 win behind a strong performance from their offense and pitching staff. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Pirates' charge with a 2-home run, 6-RBI night.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shut Down Yankees in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 1-0 victory over the New York Yankees, with Logan Gilbert earning the win after 6.0 innings of scoreless relief. Weston Wilson led the Mariners' offense with a solo home run in the contest.

top_news.title: **White Sox RHP Davis Martin Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Chicago White Sox right-handed pitcher Davis Martin has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right middle finger blister.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles acquired center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox on August 12, 2026, as part of the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade. The Red Sox will receive a player to be named later.
